text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual: observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather. Steps found in the weekly mean residual. RO-NC is the refit-offset neighbour-count detector. The neighbour tag is loose: any opposite step elsewhere within 4 weeks.'
text.tspan: 13 Primary substations with at least 24 months of data, January 2022 to June 2026. Residual:
observed power minus experiment 17's model frozen at its first origin, ERA5 weather.
Steps found in the weekly mean residual.
RO-NC is the refit-offset neighbour-count detector.
The neighbour tag is loose: any opposite step elsewhere within 4 weeks.
